stage: PRE-REGISTERED harness validation / falsification test, STAGE 2 of aw's escalation ladder: 3e16 (10x Stage 1's budget), 6 fresh seeds, same easy48 panel
why_this_matters: This is the experiment most likely to overturn the programme's headline claim, and the preprint itself names it as the first thing a skeptical reader should ask for. It is run BEFORE publication, not after, and its result will be reported whichever way it falls.
primary_endpoint: transition_count (recall > 0.8), paired by seed; primary statistic McNemar exact
preregistered_escalation_ladder: Stage 1 (this launch): 3e15, 8 paired seeds. If the transformer crosses in >=1 seed, the harness is validated and the campaign stops -- no escalation. If it crosses in 0 of 8, Stage 2 runs 3e16 (10x) on 6 seeds. If that is also 0/6, Stage 3 runs 1e17 on 3 seeds. Only after Stage 3 returns 0/3 is the falsifying outcome declared. Escalation thresholds are fixed here, before any result is seen, so that a null cannot be rescued by unbounded budget-hunting.

preregistered_gate.transformer_transitions_eq_0_means: ESCALATE_STAGE3 (1e17, 3 fresh seeds) -- unless candidate control also fails
preregistered_gate.candidate_control_note: ceil(1.0*6*0.6)=4, scaled from Stage 1's observed stablegla rate 8/8=1.0; if candidate falls below this the panel/config is broken and the run is INCONCLUSIVE for both arms, same as Stage 1's own candidate_control gate

parent_decision: Stage 1 (3e15, 8 paired seeds 2300-2307): stablegla candidate-control 8/8 crossed (recall 1.0 all seeds); transformer 0/8 crossed (recalls 0.178-0.406, none above 0.8 threshold); McNemar exact one-sided p=0.00390625. Per the pre-registered ladder this is NOT the falsifying outcome -- it mechanically triggers this Stage 2.
operator: Claude (headless autonomous tick), executing aw's own pre-registered, mechanical escalation ladder -- no new judgment introduced
notes: Same harness files verified byte-identical to K reference and to aw's own pinned hashes before launch. run_aw.py copied verbatim unmodified from aw/shard0 (fully parameterized by manifest.json -- budget/seeds/panel are the only inputs that change). Fresh salt + fresh seeds 2208-2213, never used in any prior campaign. Seed split [2,2,1,1] across the 4 GPUs is the most even split of 6 seeds over 4 shards; shards with 2 seeds run ~2x longer (~5.7h est. at 10x Stage 1's ~35min/4-run wall) than the 1-seed shards, but all four report into the same decision.json via monitor.py. No efficacy stopping.
